title: Status of association policies.
bodyText: All financial institutions shall consider a policy issued by the association to be the same as a similar policy issued by an insurer authorized to transact insurance in this State.
bodyHtml: [§431:21-118]  Status of association policies.  All financial institutions shall consider a policy issued by the association to be the same as a similar policy issued by an insurer authorized to transact insurance in this State. [L 1991, c 284, pt of §2]
